selection_basis: Public metadata only: a different repository from exposed Polly, Serilog, Autofac and CsvHelper tasks; recent baseline suitable for investigating existing SDK project support. No issue, solution or test content used in selection.
evaluation_question: Can real B investigate a different repository, choose authorized edit targets and revise using public observations through the current normal product entry?
why: 为什么要有它：先按元数据固定题目和产品版本，再建立公开输入与独立验收，避免按答案或运行结果挑题。
